description.value: Your telepathy is stronger than most mecenaicsʼ, allowing you to enhance your psychic communications with others. You can transmit simple images alongside your messages whenever you use limited telepathy. In addition, when a creature communicates with you via telepathy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] against that creature.
